notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI could not connect. The system hung up, and the caller heard nothing at all

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI malfunctioned; the call was sent to voicemail

notify.h_reject_list.back: number on the blacklist: played a message saying it cannot be reached then hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: The system judged this to be a sales / fraud call ({t}) but stalling is turned off, so the AI answered as normal

notify.h_stall_released.back: At first the system thought it was a sales / fraud call, but on the second check it found it was a normal call, so the AI went back to talking as normal

notify.h_stall_spam.back: The system judged this to be a sales / fraud call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept talking to stall the caller

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: The system judged this to be a sales / fraud call, so the AI deliberately kept talking to stall the caller

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: The caller said it was urgent. The phone called the phone's owner but could not reach them, and the AI told the caller that the owner will call back soon. This call is not seen as a sales or fraud call that needs stalling. What needs doing is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: The caller said it was urgent. The phone called the phone's owner, the owner answered and was connected to the caller, and then the AI left the call. This call is not seen as a sales or fraud call that needs stalling

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: The caller said it was urgent and the phone's owner was notified immediately. This call is not seen as a sales or fraud call that needs stalling. What needs doing is to call them back as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked.note: Blacklist title; 'บัญชีดำ' used for blacklist

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played “{}” then hung up. No AI used

notify.n_named_number.note: Order swapped to name then number (number in brackets) because the checker rejects text identical to English

notify.n_repeat_body.back: {count} more calls came in from {number} in the past minute. The system did not notify about them one by one

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read this message, it means the notification channel works now

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI could not connect. The system hung up]

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI could not connect and did not say anything

call.speech.im_here.back: I'm here, I can hear clearly, go ahead and speak.

Uses female-only particles ค่ะ/คะ although the owner's sex is unknown; it should be gender-neutral wording (or follow an owner setting). (Translator note: Uses ค่ะ/คะ (female particle) as a guess; swap to ครับ for a male owner)

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello, are you still on the line?

call.speech.bye.note: fixed: removed female-only particles, now gender-neutral. Uses female-only particles ค่ะ/คะ although the owner's sex is unknown; it should be gender-neutral wording (or follow an owner setting). call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, wait, let me ask one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: “wait a moment”, “let me check first”, “let me take a look first”, “give me a moment”
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only the quoted Thai phrases separated by commas, no full sentence. Not a phrase list: the English is just the quoted phrases ("just a sec", "give me a moment", "let me see"), but this adds "ห้ามพูดว่า" (Do not say ...), which breaks the prompt that already says "Do not say ... in Thai that is lines like <this>"; it should be only the quoted Thai phrases. (Translator note: Examples of Thai phrases meaning 'wait a moment / let me check')

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have called cannot be reached at this time. Please call again later.

call.speech.preview.back: ["Hello?", "Oh, a parcel? Sure, you can leave it in front of the door. Thanks.", "Okay, bye-bye."]
call.speech.preview.note: fixed: lines 2 and 3 now gender-neutral, no female-only particles. Lines 2 and 3 use female-only particles คะ/ค่ะ although the owner's sex is unknown; it should be gender-neutral wording (or follow an owner setting).

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: farewell / bye-bye / talk again later / see you; wrapups: that's all for now / that's it for now; ends examples: "Thank you, goodbye (female)." / "Okay (male), talk again later (male)." / "Bye-bye (female)."; not_ends: "Hello, hi (female), I'm calling from the bank." / "Give me a moment first (female)." / "Don't say goodbye yet."
call.speech.closing.note: Examples mix ครับ and ค่ะ on purpose; farewell words taken from the existing list

call.hello.hello_again.note: fixed: removed female-only particle, now gender-neutral. Uses the female-only particle คะ although the owner's sex is unknown; it should be gender-neutral wording (or follow an owner setting). (Translator note: Uses คะ (female particle); a guess about the owner's sex)

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy the incoming webhook link (works with Mattermost too) or fill in the bot token with the channel ID, either one. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket mode then fill in the bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-) and channel ID

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the workspace -> Apps & integrations -> Webhooks -> Add webhook then copy the URL link (requires a Google Workspace account)

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration -> Workspace -> Integrations -> New -> Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook link

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, long-lived access token (Profile -> Security) and notify service name such as mobile_app_pixel_9 (seen in Developer tools -> Actions)

console.hint_ifttt.back: See your key at ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation then create an applet "When Webhooks receives a web request" using the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the message

console.nf_nextcloud_target.note: Translated as โทเค็นบทสนทนา while other token fields keep the Latin word Token; acceptable because it is a Nextcloud-specific term.

console.er_task_ph.note: The line break before "or:" in en was dropped; times were localized (7 pm to 1 ทุ่ม, 8 pm to 2 ทุ่ม) and are correct. Restoring the break is optional.

console.er_oc_voicemail.note: "ฝากข้อความเสียง" reads as a verb (left a voicemail) while the notification and other labels use the noun ข้อความเสียง; acceptable as an outcome label.
